title: Capture media inspection
responsibility: Checks PNG and WAV evidence structure and returns image dimensions, audio duration or a reason it cannot be read.

inputs.name: pngChecksum.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes over which to compute the PNG-style CRC-32.

inputs.name: mediaFacts.bytes
inputs.description: Original image or audio bytes to inspect.

inputs.name: mediaFacts.mediaType
inputs.description: Declared MIME type: image/png, audio/wav or audio/x-wav are supported.

outputs.name: pngChecksum
outputs.description: Unsigned CRC-32 checksum of the supplied bytes.

outputs.name: mediaFacts
outputs.description: Image width/height or audio duration in seconds rounded to six decimals; otherwise an error description for unsupported type, damaged container, checksum, compressed pixels or audio format.
